arguments.name: environment
arguments.description: OpenShift environment name used to isolate the session kubeconfig (letters, numbers, '.', '_' and '-').

arguments.name: operation
arguments.description: OpenShift operation to run; give either this or operations.

arguments.name: operations
arguments.description: Resource paths per operation (create, apply, replace) run in that order; cannot be combined with operation or resources.

arguments.name: resources
arguments.description: Resource YAML path or list of paths for get, create, apply, replace and delete.

arguments.name: api_url
arguments.description: OpenShift API server URL; required for login.

arguments.name: insecure_skip_tls_verify
arguments.description: Skip TLS certificate verification on login.

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.description: Project to switch to for the project operation; when omitted the current project is shown.

arguments.name: command
arguments.description: oc subcommand (without 'oc') for the raw operation.

arguments.name: arguments
arguments.description: Additional string arguments appended to the oc command (resource operations and raw).

outputs.name: operation
outputs.description: Operation that was executed ('auto' for operations).

outputs.name: api_url
outputs.description: API server URL logged in to (login).

outputs.name: exit_code
outputs.description: Exit code of the oc command.

outputs.name: stdout
outputs.description: Standard output of the oc command (project, raw).

outputs.name: stderr
outputs.description: Standard error of the oc command (raw).

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Per-resource results (operation, resource, exit_code, success, stdout, stderr, duration).
